 Right Arrow OutKick Pat McAfee and Kirk Herbstreit apologize for picking SMU over Wake Forest on College GameDay
 The College GameDay hosts picked the SMU Mustangs to win, only to watch the Demon Deacons dominate from the start
 By
 Jon Root Fox News 
 Published
 November 14, 2026 4:13pm EST Comments 
 Facebook
 Twitter

 Flipboard 
 Print 
 Email 
 Add Fox News on Google 
 close Video Pat McAfee INFURIATES "Morning Joe" Scarborough Over ESPN’s College GameDay DOMINANCE | Don't @ Me w/ Dan Dakich 
 Dan shreds cable news host Joe Scarborough after he threw an on-air tantrum claiming he's "had enough of Pat McAfee ruining College GameDay" and suggested ESPN executives step in.
 What happened to SMU in north Texas was not just a beatdown. It was a shellacking of epic propositions by Wake Forest.
 Wake Forest, the 13th-ranked team in the country, entered its road matchup against unranked SMU as a 2.5-point underdog and proved the oddsmakers just as wrong as College GameDay hosts Pat McAfee and Kirk Herbstreit.
 This page may contain affiliate links to legal sports betting partners. If you sign up or place a wager, FOX News may be compensated. This content was created by a team that works independently from the FOX newsroom.
 The two picked the surging SMU Mustangs during the College GameDay broadcast at Boise State, which featured Ian Johnson, the former Broncos running back who scored the game-winning two-point conversion against Oklahoma in the 2007 Fiesta Bowl.
 WEEK 9 AP TOP 25 POLL MAKES A MOCKERY OF WAKE FOREST AND A LAUGHABLE OVERREACTION TO USC'S WIN OVER BUCKEYES 
 Kirk Herbstreit pets his dog Peter during ESPN's College GameDay on the Quad at the University of Alabama before the Alabama-Vanderbilt game on Oct. 4, 2025, in Tuscaloosa, Ala. (USA TODAY Network via Reuters Connect) 
 Fast-forward to halftime — SMU was down 42-0. The game wasn't close from the get-go, so McAfee and Herbstreit took to social media to provide a little humor and humility for their poor pick.
 "We apologize to Wake [Forest]. Wake is real," McAfee said as Herbstreit put his arm around his colleague.
 Pat McAfee and the ESPN "College GameDay" crew appear on set in front of a crowd of college football fans. (Roger Wimmer/ISI Photos/ISI Photos via Getty Images) 
 ESPN RIPPED BY FANS FOR HORRIFIC 'COLLEGE GAMEDAY' DECISION: 'RUINED THE SHOW!' 
 "I don't know what we were thinking," McAfee added as Herbstreit agreed.
 "Boy, were we wrong," Herbstreit said with a sense of astonishment.
 In my opinion, it wasn't an awful pick. SMU has a high-powered offense that put up 51 on Virginia Tech last week, but as they acknowledged in the apology video, Wake Forest has looked great too. The Demon Deacons have averaged over 50 points over the last three games.
 Pat McAfee takes the stage at ESPN College GameDay ahead of the University of Oklahoma–Michigan college football game in Norman, Oklahoma on Sept. 6, 2025. (IMAGN) 
 CLICK HERE TO DOWNLOAD THE FOX NEWS APP 
 Picking winners each week is not easy, unless you’re Steve Young , who went perfect as the guest picker when College GameDay visited BYU this season. But sometimes, when you’re wrong, you’re really wrong.
 Wake Forest went on to win 49-7. So much for that prolific SMU offense.
